name: unknown-outcome-stripped
description: an unrecognised RUN_FINISHED outcome member is stripped from its optional position with a warning, leaving the run to end exactly as an outcome-less RUN_FINISHED does
kill: make stripAgainst return the value instead of DROP when no discriminated-union member matches — the unrecognised outcome then reaches the generated validator, which rejects it, and the run fails instead of completing

dotnet.intentional: the known TS/.NET asymmetry: .NET's outcome converter is a closed union, so an unknown discriminator is a fatal JsonException rather than stripped material.
